messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 — inference-eu latency spike detected. Multiple routes showing elevated p95 and increased error retries. Pager delivered to @oncall-eu and on-call rotation.

sara: taking pager, on my way. pls add war room link and brief impact.

josh: creating war room now — https://warroom.redwood-inference/rooms/xyz-1829998888 (adhoc voice + notes).

sara: in war room. initial check: Nginx LB shows higher request queue, backend GPU pool cpu/gpu fine, KV cache miss rate spiked.

priya: customer-impact assessment: are customers seeing 5xx or just latency? we should draft status page if >5% errors or visible latencies.

aamir: telemetry: errors ~0.8% but requests with latency >2s jumped from 2% -> 18% in eu-west for model-suite: gpt-compat-v1.

sara: thanks — sounds like degraded perf (latency spike) not widespread 5xx. recommend status: "degraded performance" for EU inference.

josh: assigning primary owner to @sara (oncall). @aamir you're secondary for telemetry + logs. @priya draft comms. sam, can infra team validate LB config?

sam: on it — checking LB health and recent deploys now. no deploys in last 30m per CI.

ops-bot: Runbook invoked: /runbook inference-eu-latency -> step1: confirm owner, step2: attach war room, step3: check routing fallback.

sara: confirming owner and war room in runbook. starting mitigation: toggle increased pooling to reduce backend queued requests.

priya: status page draft (copy into status.redwood):

```
Summary: We are investigating degraded performance for inference requests in our EU region affecting response latency.
Impact: Some users may experience increased response times for text generation and embeddings in EU. No data loss reported.
Status: Investigating
Detected: 2026-03-17 14:28 UTC
Next update: in 30 minutes or sooner
```

priya: customer email template draft (short):

```
Subject: Incident: Degraded inference performance in EU region
Body: Hi — we are currently investigating higher-than-normal latency for inference requests in the EU region. Our engineers are working on mitigation; you may experience slower responses but model outputs remain intact. We’ll update within 30 minutes. — Redwood Inference Status Team
```

aamir: adding telemetry snippet: ``logs`` show repeated 502->retry patterns from the routing layer around 14:26 UTC, correlated with a KV cache TTL eviction spike.

sara: action items: 1) sam validate LB/route config (sam) 2) aamir investigate KV cache miss cause 3) josh check autoscale and GPU pool health 4) priya publish status page + customer email draft (pri) 5) sara coordinate rollback/fallback if needed.

sam: LB config looks normal; pushing a quick NGINX worker restart to clear queues (will monitor).

josh: autoscale healthy, no GPU OOMs. routing shows retries to backup pool; will temporarily increase connection limit to primary pool.

sara: I will start temporary routing fallback to lower-cost variant for high-latency requests to reduce queueing.

priya: I'll post the status page now (drafted) and prepare the customer notification list. publishing: Status -> "degraded performance".

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood-inference/incidents/1829998888 (state: investigating -> degraded performance).

ops-bot: Reminder: If paging rotation needs escalation, ping @eng-sre and @platform-leads.

sara: handoff note: if i'm paged out, leave notes in war room with steps taken and set owner in runbook.

aamir: quick checkpoint: after NGINX restart & connection limit increase, p95 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.1s over 5m sample.

sara: great, keep monitoring. priya go ahead and send customer email once we have 30m hold or next update.

priya: sending initial customer notification now to affected accounts group. will update channel when sent.

sara: final: I remain primary owner until we resolve to SLOs for 20m sustained. anyone else need a handoff?

sam: i'll stay on infra watch for 15m.

josh: i'll keep an eye on routing and autoscale for 30m.

sara: thanks team. war room remains open: https://warroom.redwood-inference/rooms/xyz-1829998888 — continue updates here. :white_check_mark:
